hook: C# with no runtime, running on a 386

beats.say: Zero C# is a fork of the bflat compiler that turns C# straight into a small native program, with no dot NET runtime and no garbage collector.
You keep the syntax, type checking, real generics, interfaces, records and C# 15 features like unions. Memory comes from arenas that are freed all at once.
The same source runs on Linux, macOS, Windows and WebAssembly, and even on DOS on a 386.
